info.title: GroupCart — Reap Wrapper
info.description: PROPOSED INTERNAL CONTRACT — not the Reap provider API. TypeScript is the source of payload schemas. This docs server does not implement payment routes. All examples are fictional; SG/SGD and merchants require verification. Orchestration owns group matching, baskets, approvals and allocation; the wrapper owns provider calls and durable operation recovery. See reap-wrapper-api.md for money-model limits and unresolved provider questions.
